prose: How do we take care of our teeth from a terrain medicine perspective? What does most holistic dentistry tend to get wrong about tooth mineralization, regeneration, and hygiene?

Master herbalist Kyle Denton returns to InnerVerse to explore holistic oral health, dental herbalism, and a terrain perspective on teeth, tongues, and mineralization. Drawing on 15 years working in the dental field, the man behind Tippecanoe Herbs brings a whole-body approach to caring for our mouths.

We explore traditional tongue assessment, tongue scraping, nutrition, stress, and the connections Kyle draws between dental health and the endocrine system. Along the way, we discuss biofield tuning, kava, black walnut, navigating dental anxiety, and choosing a dentist you can communicate with.
ext: Gum health, personalized herbal tooth powders, temporary fillings, and Kyle’s take on nano dental products.
